instruction: Help me change the VLC screenshot save location to /home/user/Pictures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to change VLC screenshot save location from default to /home/user/Pictures. The evaluator reads the vlcrc configuration file and checks if 'snapshot-path=/home/user/Pictures' is set. This is similar in complexity to the original recording path task but targets screenshot location instead.
